rural areas are more attractive to the elderly and families, but the rural areas that are more attractive are the periurban countryside.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether there is a rural/urban divide in Sweden.
migration and socio economic changes in rural/urban areas.
migration and place attachment, and how they are affected by the socio economic and spatial differentiation that has taken place in rural and urban Sweden.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the rural is attractive, but the rural attractiveness differs between urban and rural residents and between urban and rural areas, and that rural areas may be attractive for those who have a rural background.

selective migration is an important part of the explanation to why socio economic differentiation and polarization is increasing, but that the picture is not as straightforward as the polarization thesis suggests.

rural and urban areas in the Stockholm metropolitan region are characterized by socio economic and demographic polarization and that this polarization is reinforced and maintained by selective migration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
rural areas are not a dead end for those who are not born in them, but that the attraction of rural areas varies according to the socio economic characteristics of migrants.
there are both positive and negative aspects of socio economic and demographic change
rural and urban areas are not divided, but rather that they are becoming more similar. The rural is becoming more urban and the urban more rural.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the rural/urban divide is still important and that there may still be a rural migration and gentrification potential in the Swedish countryside.
the rural and the urban should not be regarded as two separate worlds, but that they are interdependent and that the rural is attractive to many.
rural areas have a great deal to offer and that there is a rural migration potential that needs to be explored and developed.
